daily.topThemeTitle: Fall Conference Season Fills the Calendar From Thessaloniki to Columbia
daily.topThemeBody: 1EdTech's Learning Impact Europe convenes in Thessaloniki September 15-17, EdTech Week and the StartEd CEO Summit head to Columbia University in October, Ed-Fi's Alliance Summit follows in November, and ISTE+ASCD's certification cohorts close enrollment September 15 and 17.

heroWeek.themeTitle: AI Surveillance and Classroom Policy Draw New Scrutiny
heroWeek.themeBody: Brookings finds AI-powered school surveillance tools deployed disproportionately in low-income, high-minority districts, while EdSurge's on-the-ground reporting shows new edtech and screen-time guidance is easier to write than to apply in a real classroom.
